course_name_original: Tecnologies del Medi Ambient i Seguretat Industrial

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to solve problems related to air, water, and soil purification.
Be able to analyze the degree of contamination of effluents from an industrial activity.
Be able to analyze the safety of an industrial activity.
Be able to identify the hazards of an industrial activity, assessing the risk and proposing prevention measures.
Be able to measure in the laboratory the different parameters related to industrial safety and analyze the degree of compliance with legislation.
Know the current regulations related to industrial safety.
Be able to analyze the degree of air, water, and soil contamination in the laboratory from samples, and compare it with the limits established in current legislation.
Be able to differentiate and select the various air, water, and soil purification systems, and classify and manage solid waste to minimize environmental impact.
Be able to understand the concept of sustainability.
Differentiate and know how to apply the various environmental certification systems that a company can have.

syllabus_topics: Air pollution. Types of pollutants. Atmospheric pollution correction systems.
Water pollution. Water quality parameters. Wastewater treatment.
Soil contamination. Causes of soil contamination. Soil recovery techniques.
Waste management. Industrial waste management. Hazardous waste. Waste assimilable to urban.
Safety of machines and work equipment.
Analysis of indoor and outdoor air quality.
Evaluation of safety conditions in the workplace: general, environmental conditions and lighting.
Evaluation of noise level in the workplace.
teaching_methods: Theoretical teachings: lectures and solving exercises and problems.
Practical teachings (laboratory): laboratory work in groups of two students under faculty supervision.
Collections of exercises and activities through the Virtual Classroom.
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum overall average grade of 5 out of 10 is required. The final exam (70% of the grade) has a minimum requirement of 4.5 out of 10, and consists of two parts (Environmental Technology and Industrial Safety), each requiring a minimum of 4.5 out of 10 to be averaged. If the minimum in the final exam is not met, the overall course grade cannot exceed 4.5 out of 10. Laboratory practice reports (15%) are not recoverable, while continuous assessment written tests (15%) are recoverable in the second call's final exam.
